author: GamingBolt
description:
DLSS 5 this, DLSS 5 that. It's a debate that's taken over conversations about games and we've been listening to all the various opinions being thrown around. We've also seen quite a few memes ridiculing the tech's latest showcase, and must admit some might have been funny if the situation were different. 

But given how much fire NVIDIA has come under, we believe it's time to put the entire debate to rest. How could we manage that you ask? All it takes is a little nuance.
title: Nvidia DLSS 5 - What The Hell Is The Controversy?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Crimson Desert has found its takers, as well as gathered a few haters along the way. While that's usually a cause for concern for a game that's been in development so long and hyped up along the way, we think that this one's a special case. We've got our reasons, but the important thing to remember is that this game isn't meant to appeal to as many people as possible.

Instead, it caters to players who like to take their time with their open worlds, diving deep into the mechanics that make such experiences tick while honing their skills and builds to take on even the most daunting threats. Join us as we take a look at why Crimson Desert may not be a game you'd like, but is definitely a game you're going to hear a lot about from those who do.
title: Crimson Desert Isn't For Everyone, And That's Okay
